analysis_settings.normalization: pixel distance / image diagonal; speed uses timestamp differences
analysis_settings.body_anchor: midpoint of shoulder and hip; requires both
analysis_settings.smoothing: centered moving average; no interpolation across missing detections or gaps

limitations: All measurements are 2D image-plane geometry; camera motion and perspective can affect them.
Activity and quality thresholds are engineering heuristics requiring validation on annotated cat videos.
Ear rotation, eye closure, gaze, emotions and diagnoses cannot be established from these landmarks alone.
Tail angular direction-change rate is an exploratory activity measure, not a validated tail-swish frequency.
SuperAnimal back_base/back_end are front/rear trunk proxies for shoulder/hip.
Unavailable landmarks: tail_mid.
Insufficient consecutive reliable samples for activity labels: tail.
